name: Humanities and Social Sciences Building
provenance: UC San Diego Facilities floor plans, converted for the classroom explorer. Rooms are scaled from their official areas and fitted to the campus-map footprint. The footprint match is weak, so neighboring buildings are not shown. Public 2025/2024 FIS rasters supply seven missing classrooms and correct the 2333A/2333B boundary assignment. Lower-floor metric scales are repaired uniformly and aligned through shared elevator/stair geometry to the unchanged L4 core.

coordinateSystem.description: Independent local meters in the inherited upper-floor frame. L1/L2 are registered to the unchanged L4 service core; campus registration remains unset.
coordinateSystem.northNote: True north is not established for the shared inherited upper-floor frame. L1/L2 use verified raster scales and service-core registration, whose rotation differs from page north. No campus orientation is asserted.

sources.title: UCSD Facilities building viewer (bkey 257)
notes: Scaled from official room areas (0.33 ft per drawing pixel); rotated 177.0 deg and fitted to the campus-map footprint on Level 4 (overlap 0.16). The match is weak, so the building is not placed among its neighbors.
